$comment: Gold queries against the LIVE corpus, run via `lab retrieval eval`. Unlike the frozen set these do not back a CI guard: the vault grows with every ingest, so metrics move for reasons unrelated to ranking. Expected references use knowledge/ paths where possible because those are committed with the parent repo and stable; vault node ids drift and may need updating. THESE ARE DRAFTS — each `notes` line states why that document is the right answer, and any judgement you disagree with should be corrected.

queries.question: What is an agent harness?
queries.notes: DRAFT — the canonical wiki defining the harness as the intermediary layer. Should rank first for the definitional question.

queries.question: Should I add more structure to the harness or rely on a smarter model?
queries.notes: DRAFT — this wiki is specifically about that tradeoff. Paraphrase query: the wiki title says 'Balancing Model Intelligence and Harness Structure', the question says neither phrase directly.

queries.question: How can I reduce the cost of running agents?
queries.notes: DRAFT — model tiering is the cost answer. Note 'reduce the cost' vs the wiki's 'cost-optimized'.

queries.question: Can parallel sub-agents talk to each other?
queries.notes: DRAFT — the hub-and-spoke constraint. The answer (no peer-to-peer) is in the body, not the title.

queries.question: How do agents keep working on something for a long time?
queries.notes: DRAFT — loop structures for long-duration tasks. Heavily paraphrased; a good test of whether lexical matching survives casual phrasing.

queries.question: Does giving an agent lots of tools hurt its performance?
queries.notes: DRAFT — two wikis both cover system prompt bloat from unused tools. Deliberately multi-answer, so nDCG is more meaningful than recall here.

queries.question: How do I limit the blast radius of a compromised credential?
queries.notes: DRAFT — least-privilege IAM roles. Included as an off-domain control: the corpus is mostly LLM material, so this checks that a distinct topic is not drowned out.

queries.question: Why go ESM-only?
queries.notes: DRAFT — very short query with one rare, high-signal term. Tests that brevity does not hurt.

queries.question: What is the capital city of Portugal?
queries.notes: Control. Nothing local should be relevant; precision@k must stay 0. This is the live equivalent of the frozen off-corpus guard.
